2026_03_NYJ_DET.headline: Bailey-Sewell trench battle meets Wilson’s chance against Detroit’s battered back end
2026_03_NYJ_DET.paragraph1: New York can test Detroit through Geno Smith and Garrett Wilson, especially with the Lions trying to clean up coverage communication after allowing explosive plays. The counterweight is up front: rookie David Bailey’s early pressure production runs directly into All-Pro tackle Penei Sewell, a matchup that can determine whether Smith gets time to attack. Detroit also enters with offensive-line injuries, while the Jets are managing several offensive and special-teams absences, putting protection and depth under added strain.
2026_03_NYJ_DET.model_rationale: New York’s route threats become more dangerous if protection holds, while Detroit’s ability to control the edge and avoid coverage breakdowns can keep its offense in favorable game script.
